changes.old: The permanent file for the ARDEF (Account Range Definition) Table, which is used to control the accuracy of Edit Package processing. The table contains all valid ARDEF entries, namely: the account prefix range, its associated Issuing Identifier, card-number length indicator, check-digit indicator, product ID and account funding source..
changes.new: The permanent file for the ARDEF (Account Range Definition) Table, which is used to control the accuracy of Visa Clearing Exchange (VCX) processing. The table contains all valid ARDEF entries, namely: the account prefix range, its associated Issuing Identifier, card-number length indicator, check-digit indicator, product ID, and account funding source.
changes.ai_reason: El texto modifica el propósito del procesamiento de la ficha de ARDEF de 'Edit Package' a 'Visa Clearing Exchange (VCX)', lo que implica un cambio en la funcionalidad y significado de negocio.

changes.old: The outgoing Center Transaction File contains interchange transactions generated by a processing center's pre-edit program. If the format is acceptable to the Edit Package, it is converted to an ITF and is submitted to the VIC.The incoming Center Transaction File contains ITF data transmitted from the VIC through the VAP to the Edit Package for processing. If there are no errors, the ITF is converted to a CTF and used as input to the post-edit program.
changes.new: The outgoing Center Transaction File contains interchange transactions generated by a processing center's pre-edit program. If the format is acceptable to Visa Clearing Exchange (VCX), it is converted to an ITF and is submitted to the VIC. The incoming Center Transaction File contains ITF data transmitted from the VIC through the VAP to VCX for processing. If there are no errors, the ITF is converted to a CTF and used as input to the post-edit program.
changes.ai_reason: El texto describe lo mismo pero se reemplazó 'Edit Package' por 'Visa Clearing Exchange (VCX)' y se ajustó el flujo de información para mejorar la claridad sin alterar el significado.

changes.old: The outgoing Interchange Transaction File contains transactions sent to VisaNet by an endpoint. This file may be created by the outgoing Edit Package after the endpoint's pre-edit processing, or it may be sent directly to VisaNet. The incoming Interchange Transaction File contains transactions delivered to an endpoint by VisaNet. This file may be read by the Edit Package prior to the transaction being processed by the endpoint's post-edit processing, or it may be directly processed by the endpoint.
changes.new: The outgoing Interchange Transaction File (ITF) contains transactions sent to VisaNet by an endpoint. This file may be created by the outgoing Visa Clearing Exchange (VCX) after the endpoint's pre-edit processing, or it may be sent directly to VisaNet. The incoming ITF contains transactions delivered to an endpoint by VisaNet. This file may be read by VCX prior to the transaction being processed by the endpoint's post-edit processing, or it may be directly processed by the endpoint.
changes.ai_reason: El texto describe el mismo concepto con cambios menores en la redacción, como añadir el término 'Visa Clearing Exchange (VCX)' y ajustar la referencia a 'ITF' sin alterar el significado.

changes.new: A file containing Routing table update records that is created through incoming Visa Clearing Exchange (VCX) processing for all clients subscribing to the Plus ATM system. The TC 33 Extract Table contains Plus card issuing Identifiers.
changes.ai_reason: El texto describe lo mismo pero cambia 'Edit Package' por 'Visa Clearing Exchange (VCX)' para ser más preciso en el contexto del sistema Visa.

changes.old: The entity, operated or designated by a clearing client of Visa, responsible for processing of interchange transactions. It executes the Edit Package and the pre- or post-edit programs, or both, and sends and receives interchange transactions to and from a VIC. A single processing center may function as an acquirer center, an issuer center, or both. It performs interchange transaction services for one client or a multiple number of clients. Most BASE II processing centers are operated by Visa clients; nonclient processing centers may be authorized to process Visa transactions.
changes.new: The entity, operated or designated by a clearing client of Visa, responsible for processing of interchange transactions. It executes Visa Clearing Exchange (VCX) and the pre- or post-edit programs, or both, and sends and receives interchange transactions to and from a VIC. A single processing center may function as an acquirer center, an issuer center, or both. It performs interchange transaction services for one client or a multiple number of clients. Most BASE II processing centers are operated by Visa clients; nonclient processing centers may be authorized to process Visa transactions.
changes.ai_reason: El texto nuevo solo reemplaza 'Edit Package' por 'Visa Clearing Exchange (VCX)' sin alterar el significado o contenido real.

changes.old: See central processing date (CPD) or Edit Package processing date.
changes.new: See central processing date (CPD) or Visa Clearing Exchange (VCX) processing date.
changes.ai_reason: El texto describe lo mismo pero cambia 'Edit Package processing date' por 'Visa Clearing Exchange (VCX) processing date' para mayor claridad sin alterar el significado.

changes.old: An outgoing BASE II transaction record in which the Edit Package detected an error that affects the financial integrity of the batch. The Edit Package excludes such transactions from outgoing interchange, that is, the transaction is not included in the outgoing Interchange Transaction File forwarded to a VIC. (The batch is not rejected; all valid transactions in the batch are included in the outgoing Interchange Transaction File.) Unless the transaction is a batch or file trailer record, the run aborts.
changes.new: An outgoing BASE II transaction record in which the Visa Clearing Exchange (VCX) detected an error that affects the financial integrity of the batch. The VCX excludes such transactions from outgoing interchange, that is, the transaction is not included in the outgoing Interchange Transaction File (ITF) forwarded to a VIC. (The batch is not rejected; all valid transactions in the batch are included in the outgoing ITF.) Unless the transaction is a batch or file trailer record, the run aborts.
changes.ai_reason: El texto describe el mismo concepto con cambios menores en la redacción, como el uso de 'Visa Clearing Exchange (VCX)' en lugar de 'Edit Package' y ajustes en la nomenclatura de los archivos.
